transcriber_notes: SnowPro-style Windows form screenshot (705x769), no branding -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 01/01/2013 agrees with the file name. Height axis 2.7 px/cm (0 cm at y697) below 90 cm; the 90-110 cm band is compressed (46 px for 20 cm), so the top bar edge (y429) reads ~101-102 cm and HS 102 is used. Leaders give boundaries 102/87/63/46/26/19/0 (+-0.5 cm). Hardness from bar widths (origin x329; F/4F/1F/P at 13/27/53/107 px): F, 1F, 1F+ (66 px), P- (92 px), 1F, P; R-column icons agree. Temperature axis -40..0 C at 6.75 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline); the dashed air line starts at -14.2 (printed -14.0) and ends at ~-24 at the surface (printed surface temp -24.0), which is not recorded as a snow temperature. Circles at 92.5 (compressed band, approximate), 90, 80, 70, 60, 50, 40, 30 and 10 cm; circles inside the hatched bars below 50 cm are faint (+-0.3 C); no marker located at 20 or 0 cm.
